comments.author: participant1
comments.body: `Shift + Insert` by default pastes the selection clipboard (not regular paste clipboard) so when you highlight something it'll paste from it, because it's getting yanked. It's a copy paste, the same as `Ctrl + Shift + V`, just different source.
